name.en: Nevada (NDEP, 2021): stability requirements for heap leach pads

instruments: NDEP (2021) Stability requirements for heap leach pads

ndep2021.title: Nevada Division of Environmental Protection, Bureau of Mining Regulation and Reclamation (2021). Stability requirements for heap leach pads

items.instrument: NDEP (2021) Stability requirements for heap leach pads

summary.es: FS estático mínimo recomendado del pad; modos infinito, rotacional y traslacional (ítem 5).
summary.en: Minimum recommended static FoS of the pad; infinite, rotational and translational modes (item 5).

items.instrument: NDEP (2021) Stability requirements for heap leach pads

summary.es: FS seudoestático mínimo recomendado, con la PGA de 10 % de excedencia en 50 años (ítem 3); el kh lo da el usuario.
summary.en: Minimum recommended pseudo-static FoS, with the PGA of 10% exceedance in 50 years (item 3); the user gives kh.

items.instrument: NDEP (2021) Stability requirements for heap leach pads

summary.es: Con FS seudoestático menor que 1.05 se exige un análisis de deformación (Newmark) con la PGA completa; el caso de PGA reducida no se revisa.
summary.en: A pseudo-static FoS below 1.05 requires a deformation (Newmark) analysis with the full PGA; the reduced-PGA case is not checked.
